The skill bundle is benign, designed to fetch live Kalshi sports markets using the browser. The `SKILL.md` explicitly constrains the AI agent to use only the browser tool and prohibits `web_search` or `web_fetch` for market data, limiting potential attack vectors. There are no instructions for data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence, or prompt injection attempts against the agent.
